questions.q: The second half of the distal tubule and the cortical collecting tubule of kidneys are equipped with the Principal and Intercalated cells. Of these, the Principal cells reabsorb $\mathrm{Na}^{+}$and excrete $\mathrm{K}^{+}$and are equipped with receptors for the hormone aldosterone. In primary hyperaldosteronism disease, there is an excess production of aldosterone which causes high blood pressure and $\mathrm{K}^{+}$imbalance. Spironolactone, a diuretic drug is generally used to treat these conditions. Choose the correct option for the mode of action of Spironolactone.
options: It stimulates effect of aldosterone on $\mathrm{Na}^{+}$excretion and $\mathrm{K}^{+}$reabsorption
It inhibits effect of aldosterone on $\mathrm{Na}^{+}$excretion and $\mathrm{K}^{+}$reabsorption
It stimulates effect of aldosterone on $\mathrm{Na}^{+}$reabsorption and $\mathrm{K}^{+}$excretion
It inhibits effect of aldosterone on $\mathrm{Na}^{+}$reabsorption and $\mathrm{K}^{+}$excretion

Three features of nitrogenous excretory products ($\mathrm{M}, \mathrm{N}$ and O) of animals are tabulated below.
$\begin{array}{|l|c|c|c|} \hline \text{Features of excretory products} & \text{M} & \text{N} & \text{O} \\ \hline \text{Toxicity} & \text{High} & \text{Very low} & \text{Low} \\ \hline \text{Energy cost to produce} & \text{Low} & \text{Moderate} & \text{High} \\ \hline \text{Water loss to excretion} & \text{High} & \text{Moderate} & \text{Low} \\ \hline\end{array}$ \\ The animals that secrete $\mathrm{M}, \mathrm{N}$ and O as their major excretory product would be
options: M : human, N : pigeon, O : tadpole.
M: cockroach, N: cat, O: snake.
M : crow, N: lizard, O: dog.
M : goldfish, N : rat, O : lizard.

questions.subject: Biology
questions.q: Desert animals need to conserve water. Kidneys regulate the concentration of salt and water in blood through the formation and excretion of urine. A kidney is composed of approximately one million units called nephrons. The kidneys of desert animals have modified nephrons which help them survive long periods without water. Which one of these options would be the expected modification?
options: A very long loop of Henle.
